messages.subject: New Google Groups interface
parts:
Given the recent overhaul of Google Groups, I have decided to set up a group
that will mirror the list hosted at R-Forge and serve as an alternate portal
for posting and viewing archives. The group may be accessed at:

http://groups.google.com/group/tikzdevice

Here's to having a mailing list with an actual searchable archive and an
interface that doesn't look like ass.
